Messages.Author: Jonathan_Sicari
Messages.Body:
Is the damage from a shoulder drop (and a variety of "during the press
step" type cards) unpreventable by default as prevention is a part of
strike resolution and the text of Shoulder Drop reads

"Card Text:

Grapple.

Play when you successfully inflict damage from a hand strike. After
strike resolution, if this minion is still ready, the opposing minion
takes 1 additional damage. The opposing minion cannot press this
round. A minion may play only one Shoulder Drop each strike."

I guess this would also apply to some other cards (most of which state
the damage is unpreventable anyway) that inflict damage outside of
combat.

Jonathan

Messages.Author: witness1
Messages.Body:
On Aug 17, 12:30 am, Jonathan_Sicari <jonathan_sic...@hotmail.com>
wrote:


Prevention is part of damage resolution, not strike resolution.
Shoulder Drop resolves during combat, not after, and can therefore be
prevented by combat cards that prevent damage, or other during combat
damage prevention.

-witness1

# Damage is only considered to have come from a minion if the damage
is from a strike or if an effect specifically states that the damage
is dealt by the minion. Damage from other effects is considered
"environmental," and has no particular source. [RTR 19970630]

Shoulder Drop is not a strike. It doesn't specifically state that the
damage is dealt by the minion. It therefore isn't dealt by the minion.
